name: @knowget/facilities
description: Campus Infrastructure, Facilities & Smart Environment Platform (P2-D20) — the institution's built-environment system of record: the buildings, the spaces within them, the fixed infrastructure systems that serve them, the smart-environment sensors and their readings, the operational facilities work orders, and a configurable comfort policy, with a descriptive facility profile. A pure condition engine derives space readiness and system condition rolled building → campus; a pure comfort engine derives an air-quality/comfort assessment from sensor readings against the policy thresholds. Movable/capitalized assets and their costed maintenance are Procurement & Assets' (P2-D15); money (asset valuation, maintenance cost, utility billing) is out of scope, and domain events carry no money.
